contract.code: Canonical immutable CodeType body includes nested code/constants, exception handlers, closure names and argument/bytecode structure. Filename/line tables are excluded for cross-root and LF/CRLF equivalence.
contract.namespace: Check actual function globals identity against its registered module; copied names, __wrapped__ or copied globals do not establish agreement. Include actual direct global function aliases and function closure cells within the declared graph.
contract.wrappers: Only exact source-checked stdlib contextmanager helper/closure wrapping is explicitly recognized. Local best-effort decorators are checked as real wrapper code with their actual function closures, not blindly unwrapped.
contract.bounds: At most256 binding rows,2MiB per declared source,128 compiled-byte cache entries and4096 strong code-identity cache entries. Source bytes are read afresh; no mtime cache or mutable-function cache.

Legacy original_entry_gate_sources_v1 stays structurally readable as history, but cannot match/bind a new current learned selection. No operator artifacts are backfilled.
contract.journal: sampled_entry_gate_collector_v2 stores original_entry_gate_identity_reference_v1 in each chained event.
